Rep consistency

Active months = months with sales above zero. Top account share is measured on the rep's account-level sales (Hospital, Pharmacy branches and Dispensing doctors); Ecommerce has no account detail. Flags: Lumpy = sales in fewer than 75% of the months; Concentrated = one account is 35% or more of the rep's account sales.

Brand shoppers: who buys each brand and product

This device cannot show the 3D view. The product by channel table below has the numbers.

Walkers and path widths are drawn from sell-out value, so a busier path has more shoppers. Account numbers are real counts: the distinct hospitals, outlets, doctors or online buyers that bought in the period (not patients).

Key strategy and action by HOA (DM)

Pick an HOA in the dropdown to see its row. Built from the Region, DM, MR and month selected above. Achievement is 2026 as a share of the same months in 2025, because the file has no target.

HOA (DM)Root causeImpact (achievement)Corrective actionPreventive actionTimeline

Root causes are what the sales data shows (accounts, reps, brands, channels). The reason behind each, such as stock, distributor inventory, PO or tender timing, still needs checking with the team. August 2026 is only partly loaded in the source. Timeline counts from today.

Distribution world

This device cannot show the 3D world. The sub-channel table below has the same numbers.

Trucks, boxes, tower heights and road widths are drawn from sell-out value, so a busier road has more trucks. Sub-channels: hospitals are split into government and private; the other channels are split by the distributor or marketplace that sold (Mercury Drug, South Star Drug, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok and so on). The sales file has no stock, delivery or shipment data, so the trucks are an illustration of value, not real deliveries.
